about: Every word's rootId in reading order, for the root light in quran-gpu.js. Built by tools/build_roots_table.py from s001..s114.json; little-endian arrays at the offsets below.

surahStart.about: index of each surah's first ayah in reading order; the last entry is the ayah count

ayahStart.about: index of each ayah's first word in reading order; the last entry is the word count

roots.about: each word's rootId (roots.json index + 1), 0 for a word without a root
